payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate all ordered pairs of flamingos to define lines; if line hits x-axis at integer x in [1,n], update max count for that binocular. Sum per-binocular maxes.
payload.rationale: No branch-and-bound/pruning; pure brute-force pair enumeration. None of candidate subtypes fit perfectly; branch_and_bound selected as highest-scoring complete_search option despite inaccuracy.
